rationale: Full exact-model validation regressed from parent macro70.1171 to67.6957 vs paper74.27. EmbSpatial72.86 and BLINK76.61 are substantial regressions, while RefSpatial Location improved to57.92. General abilities remain broadly retained. Do not publish this candidate as an accepted final model; preserve its five key backups as a rejected non-ancestor experiment. Continue from the fully evaluated MOPD768 parent with a lower corrective learning rate and source SAT training plus proven FSD/native/general replay. No unique causal attribution of the regression is claimed.
